children: North Korea test-fired a tactical ballistic missile on Monday, state media KCNA reported on Tuesday, adding that the test  confirmed the successful technical upgrading of an important core element for the missile, without elaborating.

The announcement comes after South Korea's military said on Monday that North Korea had fired multiple ballistic missiles toward the sea off its east coast. It was Pyongyang's fourth launch in a month, following Seoul's recent test of a hypersonic missile.
Meanwhile, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un on Sunday visited a defence industry museum showcasing weapons achievements made under his leadership.
Kim said the country's weaponry, which promotes North Korea's position, "will be developed and completed in a more strenuous manner", KCNA reported.
